visualCharacteristics.purpose: single row of uppercase legal/corporate links (Terms & Conditions, Privacy, Security, Careers, About us, Contact us) with a brand/home link (CITI.COM) on the left

contentPattern.structure: one row: first cell holds the brand or home link (text, logo or heading); further cells (or a list) hold the legal links. Any non-link copy, such as a copyright line, is kept below the links

usage: Use at the very bottom of product pages for the corporate legal link row.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any horizontal row of legal/utility links. Long disclosure copy belongs in legal-disclosures; the site footer is built by the footer block.
